subject: FinFlow 503 spike on May 18 — outage entitlement & analysis invite
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finflow.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 20:12:00 +0000
Subject: Spike of 503s and latency — May 18 (us-west-2)

Diego,

We saw a sustained spike of 503 responses and tail latency from 2027-05-18T20:14:00Z to ~2027-05-18T20:49:00Z on our checkout path (us-west-2). Our customer transactions failed and we took a revenue hit this evening. Attached are a small sample of our client-side traces and the times we saw 503s.

Can you please confirm whether this qualifies as an SLA incident and how we should proceed for credits and a post-incident review? We need a formal window and any evidence we can include for our internal audit.

Sample hits:
- 2027-05-18T20:16:04Z — 503 (checkout-token)
- 2027-05-18T20:21:39Z — 524 (gateway timeout)
- 2027-05-18T20:42:11Z — 503 (checkout-submit)

I appreciate anything you can share.

--
Sanjay Rao
Head of Engineering, FinFlow
ops@finflow.com
[Attachment: finflow_client_traces.zip (ZIP, 1.2MB)]

Diego

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:45:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Spike of 503s and latency — May 18 (us-west-2)

Quick findings after an initial pass:
- Preliminary availability window (service-observed): 2027-05-18T20:15:30Z to 2027-05-18T20:50:10Z (roughly 34m40s). This aligns closely with FinFlow's client-side traces.
- Root cause hypothesis: transient autoscaler instability during a burst rollout combined with a prefix cache eviction; several worker pods concurrently restarted and we saw a brief period where requests routed to warmup instances that were not yet accepting requests.
- Impact: ~2.8% request drop on the checkout route, increased p95/p99 latency for 12 minutes during the middle of the window.

I've uploaded the raw traces and a telemetry export to a shared folder and attached a trimmed trace bundle here for the customer's evidence package.

Attachments:
- raw_trace_bundle.tar.gz (tar.gz, 24MB)
- telemetry_export.csv (CSV, 420KB)

Next recommended actions:
1) Confirm exact SLA credit amount using the reserved-tier contract formula (need the contract start/commit for pro-rata).
2) Propose a postmortem meeting — internal RCAs first, then joint review with FinFlow.

I'll prepare a short postmortem draft and proposed meeting times.

— Marcus
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: raw_trace_bundle.tar.gz (tar.gz, 24MB)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finflow.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Spike of 503s and latency — May 18 (us-west-2)

Sanjay — thanks for the report and for sharing the client traces. We completed a preliminary investigation and can confirm the service-side impact window as 2027-05-18T20:15:30Z through 2027-05-18T20:50:10Z (UTC). Marcus' team has attached the trimmed trace bundle and a short telemetry export.

Eligibility and next steps:
- Eligibility: Based on the reserved-tier SLA (contract FFL-2024-07), the observed availability drop during the window meets the threshold for a proportional credit. We'll calculate the exact credit amount (pro-rata for the affected interval) and share the settlement proposal by EOD Friday.
- Evidence package: Attached are the raw_trace_bundle.tar.gz and telemetry_export.csv you can attach to your audit or finance team. We also placed a curated set of traces and the early postmortem draft in the shared Drive link below.
- Postmortem: We'd like to schedule a joint 60-minute review to walk through the timeline, root cause, mitigations, and a remediation plan. Proposed slots: 2027-05-21 15:00 UTC or 2027-05-22 09:00 UTC. I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm a preferred slot.

Files/links:
- Evidence bundle: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleTraceFolder
- Proposed postmortem: https://docs.google.com/document/d/postmortem-draft (internal draft attached)

If you need anything faster (e.g., an expedited credit) let me know and I'll route it through finance.

Thanks again and apologies for the disruption — we're treating this as high priority.

Diego Fernandez
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0191
[Attachments: raw_trace_bundle.tar.gz (tar.gz, 24MB), telemetry_export.csv (CSV, 420KB), postmortem-draft.md (MD, 5KB)]
